# qq host ownership map

Source and tests win. Read the index first, then route to only the ownership
boundary needed for the job.

- [`host`](host.md) — process composition, sibling plugins, HMR, project catalog,
  execution profiles, host file capabilities, or cross-sibling boot behavior.
- [`sessions`](sessions.md) — session lifecycle, persistence, scope, switching,
  parent/child shape, or resume behavior.
- [`architect`](architect.md) — architect attach/delegate semantics, child return
  addresses, or architect-only context and tools.
- [`land`](land.md) — the complete landing machine: capsules, Git identity,
  merge ownership, QA/review, stores, routing, and recovery.
- [`relay`](relay.md) — mailbox identity, labels, delivery, and settlement.
- [`ui`](ui.md) — console rendering, navigation, transcript projection, gestures,
  responsive chrome, and file affordances.
- [`dictation`](dictation.md) — voice capture, recognition, and dictation HTTP
  boundaries.
